answer: A credential ripens once a year and rots if it is not picked. Plumber master licence with trade board attestation is the harvest: four-year apprenticeship, 8,000 supervised hours, master exam, annual renewal. The dawn is the season — the same small fee, the same form, the same inspection, returning whether the holder is ready or not. A ring must tend a hundred harvests on schedule, and the fable is the tending for one: appearances, fees, fresh signatures, year after year, for identities that earn nothing between seasons. The quartz is the register's current edition, which forgets the unpicked.
